extra_inputs.name: cc-1.4.5.crate
extra_inputs.reason: scripts.d/50-rav1e.sh runs `cargo update cc` at build time, which moves the lockfile's cc to the newest compatible 1.x on crates.io. The newest 1.x published before the job started (2026-09-06T12:33:10Z) is 1.4.5 (published 2026-09-04T09:28:57Z). If BtbN's Docker layer cache reused an older rav1e layer, an older 1.x was used instead; the exact version cannot be read from the binary because cc is a build-script helper that is not linked into ffmpeg.exe. Included for completeness.

known_gaps: The upstream zip is no longer downloadable (BtbN pruned the dated release) and was not mirrored. The binary's identity rests on the SHA-256 pin in packaging/hunter_cam.spec at 1a81579, the embedded version string and the configure cross-check.

Compilers are identified from strings embedded in the binary rather than from a pinned image: BtbN's images install Ubuntu packages, `rustup` stable and a crosstool-NG clone at image-build time. The binary itself names GCC 15.2.0 built by crosstool-NG 1.28.0.23_185f348 and rustc commit 8bab26f4f68e (Rust 1.97.1); those sources are included under toolchain/.

General-purpose build tools (Ubuntu packages, cmake, meson, nasm, cargo-c, binutils, the compiler's own host libraries gmp/mpfr/mpc/isl) are not part of the linked work and are not included by default (GPLv3 section 1 excludes general-purpose tools used unmodified). binutils 2.46.0 can be added with --with-optional-toolchain.

BtbN's CI reuses Docker layer caches (cache-from). A stage layer is only reused when its Dockerfile instruction and mounted stage script/download cache are unchanged, so a cached layer was built from the same pinned source recorded here.

`.git` metadata is removed from every fetched tree so the archive is byte-reproducible; each stage archive's SOURCE-REVISIONS.scoutmind.txt keeps the commit and remote of every repository. Some projects derive cosmetic version strings from git metadata at build time (for example x264's build number).

rav1e: `cargo update cc` re-resolved the cc build dependency at build time (see extra_inputs: best determination cc 1.4.5). All crates linked into ffmpeg.exe come from rav1e's committed Cargo.lock, which the archive vendors with checksum verification.
Only bin/ffmpeg.exe is redistributed by ScoutMind (ffprobe.exe and ffplay.exe from the same zip are not shipped); the same sources cover all three.
